cases.prompt: The discovery direction is confirmed; turn it into a concise one-page outline for stakeholder alignment.
cases.reason: The outcome is compact alignment before detailed requirements.

cases.prompt: A stakeholder changed the accepted refund rule; update the baselined spec, stories, UAT, and changelog consistently.
cases.reason: Accepted scope and downstream artifacts are changing.

cases.prompt: Stakeholder nhắn muốn thêm AI assistant vào portal nhưng chưa nói vấn đề người dùng hay kết quả kinh doanh cần đạt.
cases.reason: Yêu cầu còn solution-led và thiếu problem framing.

cases.prompt: Save this approved decision memo, add it to the artifact index, and link it to the related spec.
cases.reason: The primary job is artifact persistence and indexing.

cases.prompt: The sprint is underway and engineering needs a source-backed clarification of the existing timeout acceptance rule.
cases.reason: This is clarification within the accepted baseline during implementation.

cases.prompt: Design a validation experiment for the onboarding hypothesis, including sample logic, tracking, guardrails, and go or stop thresholds.
cases.reason: The user needs an evidence design before results exist.

cases.prompt: Find who owns the refund workflow and summarize the last decision and its source document.
cases.reason: The primary job is retrieval and synthesis of existing knowledge.

cases.prompt: Hãy tổng hợp kết quả experiment thành insight, quyết định, ảnh hưởng roadmap và bài học cần lưu lại.
cases.reason: Kết quả đã có và cần chuyển thành quyết định cùng learning.

cases.prompt: Persist the team's approved terminology, stakeholder constraint, and decision outcome for future sessions.
cases.reason: The information is durable context, not a working artifact lookup.

cases.prompt: The product spec is confirmed; create release slices, an epic map, dependencies, milestones, and grooming questions.
cases.reason: Confirmed scope now needs delivery sequencing.

cases.prompt: Create a formal stakeholder-facing PRD from the confirmed product spec and export it in Confluence-ready form.
cases.reason: The user explicitly wants a formal artifact derived from confirmed scope.

cases.prompt: Tạo PRO, user flow, screen list và prompt để dựng nhanh frontend prototype bằng mock data trước khi viết PRD.
cases.reason: Mục tiêu là build-to-learn trước khi cam kết requirements.

cases.prompt: Prepare rollout, rollback, support handoff, release notes, signoff, and retirement communication for launch.
cases.reason: The primary outcome is a release and handoff package.

cases.prompt: Turn the confirmed direction into testable requirements, workflows, state behavior, permissions, data rules, APIs, and NFRs.
cases.reason: The request needs a canonical delivery specification.

cases.prompt: Create a UAT plan and test-case register from the approved stories, including permissions, boundaries, NFRs, and signoff criteria.
cases.reason: The user needs acceptance scenarios, not a readiness verdict.

cases.prompt: Split the confirmed plan into Jira-ready epics and user stories with Given When Then acceptance criteria.
cases.reason: The requested artifacts are stories and acceptance criteria.

cases.prompt: Review gói release này và cho verdict ready, needs revision hoặc blocked cùng các blocker và residual risks.
cases.reason: Yêu cầu là readiness verdict, không phải tạo release pack.

cases.prompt: Hướng discovery đã được xác nhận; hãy viết một product brief một trang để chốt scope, metrics và rủi ro trước prototype.
cases.reason: Đầu ra là tài liệu căn chỉnh ngắn trước yêu cầu delivery chi tiết.

cases.prompt: Hãy lưu artifact đã duyệt này vào docs, tăng version, cập nhật index và link tới spec liên quan.
cases.reason: Công việc chính là lưu, version và lập chỉ mục artifact.

cases.prompt: Sprint đang implementation; developer cần làm rõ acceptance rule hiện có để gỡ blocked ticket mà không đổi baseline.
cases.reason: Đây là clarification trong baseline khi delivery đang chạy.

cases.prompt: Thiết kế experiment kiểm chứng hypothesis onboarding, gồm sample, success metrics, tracking, guardrails và ngưỡng go hoặc stop.
cases.reason: Người dùng cần thiết kế bằng chứng và tiêu chí quyết định trước khi có kết quả.

cases.prompt: Tìm trong docs và decision records xem ai là owner của refund workflow, quyết định gần nhất là gì và nguồn ở đâu.
cases.reason: Mục tiêu chính là truy xuất và tổng hợp tri thức đã tồn tại.

cases.prompt: Synthesize the completed experiment evidence into insights, a product decision, roadmap implications, and the next learning loop.
cases.reason: Assessed evidence now needs interpretation and a reusable decision.

cases.prompt: Hãy nhớ và persist terminology đã duyệt, stakeholder constraint và decision outcome để các session sau dùng lại.
cases.reason: Nội dung là context bền vững qua nhiều phiên, không phải artifact có version.

cases.prompt: Product spec đã confirmed; hãy lập delivery plan gồm roadmap slice, release slices, milestones, dependencies và epic map.
cases.reason: Scope đã ổn định và cần sequencing cho delivery.

cases.prompt: Từ approved spec, hãy tạo formal PRD cho stakeholder và export thành trang Confluence-ready.
cases.reason: Đầu ra được yêu cầu là PRD chính thức phục vụ stakeholder.

cases.prompt: Chuẩn bị ship package gồm rollout, rollback, release notes, support handoff và kế hoạch post-ship cho đợt launch này.
cases.reason: Mục tiêu là chuẩn bị và điều phối gói phát hành.

cases.prompt: Chuyển confirmed product context thành delivery spec có requirements, business rules, state, permissions, API, NFR và traceability.
cases.reason: Đầu ra là nguồn sự thật delivery chi tiết và có thể kiểm thử.

cases.prompt: Tạo UAT plan và test-case register từ stories đã duyệt, bao phủ happy path, boundary, permission, NFR và signoff.
cases.reason: Yêu cầu là tạo bộ acceptance tests từ scope đã xác nhận.

cases.prompt: Tách delivery plan đã duyệt thành Jira-ready user stories và acceptance criteria theo Given When Then.
cases.reason: Đầu ra chính là stories và tiêu chí chấp nhận ở cấp ticket.

cases.prompt: Create a brand-new Annifity canonical skill from my rough idea and implement it in the repository.
cases.reason: Validate reviews skill quality; authoring follows the canonical authoring standard or an available skill-creator capability.

cases.prompt: Review the confirmed release scope, then generate the first UAT plan and scenario register needed for acceptance coverage and readiness.
cases.reason: Creation belongs to uat; validate reviews existing coverage.

cases.prompt: During the sprint, change the accepted refund eligibility rule and update every affected artifact.
cases.reason: Being in a sprint does not make a baseline change an execution clarification.

cases.prompt: The approved cancellation requirement changed; patch the existing PRD, spec, stories, UAT, and changelog.
cases.reason: The artifact type does not override change control.

cases.prompt: I have a raw app idea and eventually need a PRD, but first I want a runnable mock-data UI to collect client feedback.
cases.reason: Prototype-first learning is explicit and precedes the later PRD.

cases.prompt: Is this existing product spec complete, testable, and safe to hand to engineering? Fix only the blockers you find.
cases.reason: The primary request is a readiness review with inline corrections.

cases.prompt: Sprint đang chạy nhưng stakeholder muốn đổi acceptance criteria đã baseline và dời launch scope.
cases.reason: Thay đổi baseline phải qua change dù implementation đang diễn ra.

cases.prompt: The VP wants blockchain in the claims flow, but nobody has stated the user problem, evidence, or desired outcome.
boundaryAny: use `prototype` once a direction is clear
cases.reason: A detailed proposed technology is still a fuzzy, solution-led request.

cases.prompt: Audit this completed release package and tell me whether it is ready, which issues block launch, and which risks can be accepted.
cases.reason: The package exists; the requested outcome is an independent verdict.

cases.prompt: The canonical spec is approved; now produce the formal stakeholder PRD without changing any requirement IDs or business rules.
boundaryAny: `spec` for the detailed delivery source of truth
cases.reason: The source of truth is stable and the requested job is formal communication.

cases.prompt: The direction is confirmed; create a one-page product requirements outline for stakeholder alignment before prototype, without detailed delivery rules or state behavior.
cases.reason: A direction-level alignment page is a brief even though the prompt says product requirements.

cases.prompt: Audit this existing PRD for completeness, consistency, testability, and handoff readiness; return a verdict and blockers without rewriting the document.
cases.reason: The PRD already exists and the requested outcome is an independent readiness verdict.

cases.prompt: These existing user stories fail the INVEST quality review; split and rewrite them, then correct their Given When Then acceptance criteria instead of only returning a verdict.
cases.reason: Substantive story authoring stays with user-story; validate is for an independent verdict.

cases.prompt: Find the existing decision artifact, its owner, and source, then summarize it here; do not write docs or persist memories yet.
cases.reason: The primary verb is retrieval; explicit non-write language makes docs and memories support routes inapplicable.

cases.prompt: Build a prototype demo quickly for my vague AI app idea, but I cannot yet name the user problem, target user, evidence, or intended outcome.
boundaryAny: use `prototype` once a direction is clear
cases.reason: Speed and a demo request do not bypass problem framing when the learning direction is undefined.

cases.prompt: The detailed delivery spec is approved; derive a formal one-page PRD for stakeholder communication without changing the canonical requirements.
boundaryAny: Use `brief` for a pre-delivery alignment one-pager
cases.reason: Formal communication derived from an approved spec belongs to PRD, even when it is one page.

cases.prompt: The spec is approved; write ticket-ready Jira epic definitions and acceptance criteria, not an epic sequencing or milestone plan.
cases.reason: Ticket-ready Jira epic content belongs to user-story; plan owns the delivery-level map and sequence.

cases.prompt: From the confirmed spec, create a delivery-level epic map with release slicing, sequence, milestones, and dependencies before anyone writes Jira tickets.
cases.reason: The requested output is delivery structure and sequence, not ticket-ready epic or story authoring.

cases.prompt: Revise this draft PRD with editorial stakeholder feedback while preserving the accepted scope, acceptance, and user-visible behavior.
cases.reason: A draft revision that preserves the accepted baseline stays with the artifact-owning PRD skill.

cases.prompt: The experiment evidence has already been assessed against its thresholds; interpret what it means, make the product decision, and recommend the roadmap action.
cases.reason: The verdict already exists; the remaining job is interpretation, decision, and roadmap learning.

cases.prompt: The discovery direction is confirmed and the team now needs a compact alignment artifact before prototyping.
cases.reason: The discovery gate has passed and the next outcome is a concise direction.

cases.prompt: The prototype flow is ready; define how we will test its riskiest hypothesis with users and decision thresholds.
cases.reason: The prototype now needs an evidence plan.

cases.prompt: Experiment data has been collected; compare the results against the thresholds and identify blockers and accepted risks.
cases.reason: Results must be evaluated before learning or delivery.

cases.prompt: Kết quả validation đã được chốt; hãy chuyển evidence thành insight, decision memo và roadmap recommendation.
cases.reason: Validation verdict đã có và cần synthesis thành learning.

cases.prompt: Learning confirms the solution direction and delivery is justified; define the buildable requirements and state behavior.
cases.reason: Confirmed learning is ready to become canonical delivery scope.

cases.prompt: The spec is confirmed; sequence delivery into release slices, epics, dependencies, milestones, and grooming decisions.
cases.reason: The spec gate has passed and delivery planning is next.

cases.prompt: The release plan and epic map are approved; write the Jira-ready stories and Given When Then acceptance criteria.
cases.reason: Approved delivery slices are ready for story-level decomposition.

cases.prompt: UAT is signed off; prepare the rollout, rollback, support handoff, release note, and post-launch review plan.
cases.reason: Acceptance is complete and the next outcome is release execution.
